editorial: **November to February**: Cambodia’s “winter” brings the most moderate weather and the best views—but also massive crowds.

**June to September**: We visited in mid-August, smack in the middle of the wet season. The views of Angkor Wat were less spectacular, but we could get up close and had the World Heritage Site almost to ourselves in the afternoon. A film playing at our hotel showed peak-season crowds that looked twenty times larger than what we encountered.
**March to May, October**: Winter offers the best views; monsoon brings lower prices and smaller crowds. The rest of the year is best avoided because of the extreme heat.
